description: This bar chart illustrates accuracy values for a multi-retrieval task, broken down by different attributes. The horizontal axis displays the model names – Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Interlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b – presented in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Four sets of bars are presented for each model, representing the attributes “hobby” (peachpuff), “university” (lightsteelblue), “major” (plum), and “birthdate” (lightgreen). Within each model grouping, the bars are arranged in the order hobby, university, major, and birthdate. The height of the bars represents the accuracy value; for example, for the Qwen2.5-7b-1M model, the bars have approximate heights of 74, 78, 72, and 30 for hobby, university, major, and birthdate respectively. For the Qwen2.5-7b model, the bars have approximate heights of 83, 80, 62, and 18 for hobby, university, major, and birthdate respectively. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
